NOTE
**Still not ready: commit messages and screenshots unchanged**

New: The author pushed once and said the changes are made. Commit messages are unchanged, and the PR description still has "Fixes part of: #16094" and the same wide screenshots. Missing: the commit message fixes (remove "Fixes a part of", add "Fixes: #16094" after the description in the last commit) and precise before/after screenshots.

###### Next step

Keep "not ready" and leave the PR unassigned until the author fixes these.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for the update! The commit messages still look unchanged (please remove "Fixes a part of" and put "Fixes: #16094" after the description in the last commit), and the screenshots still show a lot of unchanged UI. Please crop them to just the changed part, following the [precise before/after screenshots guide](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/presenting-visual-changes.html#what-are-precise-before-after-screenshots).
```
